batch.description: Jahangirnagar University H Unit, academic session 2016-2017, Set-1 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU question bank), book PDF pp.268-277 (printed pp.83-92 of Part 2). Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); where both forms occur (Q2, Q9, Q19) they never disagree in this paper. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The paper is printed in THREE syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (heading on book PDF p.268) carries 56 questions, the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.275, continuing on pp.276-277) carries 23, and a single-question 'Old Syllabus' block (heading at the foot of book PDF p.277) carries Q69 only; together they partition the printed numbers 1-80 exactly once, and each question's tier is recorded in its topic field. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-5, English Q6-20, Physics Q21-40, Higher Mathematics Q41-80 — counts Bangla 5, English 15, Physics 20, Higher Mathematics 40. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.268 carries Q1-13; p.269 carries Q14-22, 25, 27, 28; p.270 carries Q29-33, 35, 37-40, 42; p.271 carries Q43-45; p.272 carries Q46-48, 50, 51; p.273 carries Q52, 53, 65, 66, 70-72; p.274 carries Q73-76, 79; p.275 (Extra Syllabus) carries Q23, 24, 26, 34, 36, 41, 49, 54; p.276 (Extra Syllabus) carries Q55-62; p.277 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q63, 64, 67, 68, 77, 78, 80 and (Old Syllabus) Q69. Keys: 79 keyed single_choice, exactly ONE dual key — Q77, whose printed tag reads '[Ans: a, b]' and which is therefore encoded multiple_choice with both ids — 0 printed no-correct-option dispositions, and 0 keyless questions. Preserved print anomalies: Q8(c) prints 'didn't' with no object; Q14(c) prints 'ornace'; Q29(d) prints π/190 rads^-1; Q32(c) prints the gravitational-potential unit as 'Jkg' with no ^-1; Q36 prints the car's uniform velocity with the acceleration unit ms^-2; Q41's options (a) and (c) print the dipole-moment unit as 'Am' against 'Am^2' in (b) and (d); Q44's stem prints the point as lowercase 'p'; Q48(d) prints only '(±2, 0)' with no eccentricity value; Q58's stem prints 'কমপক্ষে 0 জন' (at least 0 students); Q61(c) prints the reversed inequality chain '0 ≤ x ≥ 11/6'; Q63(c) prints '≤ -1/2' with no variable; Q75's stem prints 'স্থির অবস্থা থেকে'; Q80's stem prints the vector as plain 'A' with no arrow. Content-versus-block anomalies (subject follows the printed number range throughout): Q33 is chemistry-flavoured although its number places it in the Physics block, and Q41 is a physics question (coil dipole moment) although its number places it in the Higher Mathematics block. No question in this paper carries a figure or diagram; diagrams or tables appear only inside the printed worked solutions (Q44, Q70, Q72, Q75 and Q76 carry solution diagrams; Q54 and Q55 carry solution tables). BOUNDARY NOTE: the book map's span for this paper (pp.268-287) is WRONG — book PDF p.278 carries the header of a DIFFERENT paper, JU H Unit 2016-2017 Set-3, so this paper is pp.268-277 ONLY; p.267 belongs to the previous paper (H 2017-2018 Set-6) and nothing outside pp.268-277 is included here. sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section, banner 'প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৬-১৭') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-1 of JU H Unit 2016-2017 occupies printed pp.83-92 = book PDF pp.268-277: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.268-274, the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning on printed p.90 (book PDF p.275) and continuing on printed pp.91-92 (book PDF pp.276-277), and a one-question 'Old Syllabus' block (Q69) at the foot of printed p.92 (book PDF p.277). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.268) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৬-২০১৭ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-1, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. The following paper, H Unit 2016-2017 Set-3, begins on printed p.93 (book PDF p.278); the book map's pp.268-287 span for Set-1 is therefore incorrect and pp.278-287 are excluded. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image (300-dpi renders), with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops) for Q1-Q6, Q14-Q15, Q21-Q22, Q25, Q27, Q29-Q33, Q35-Q36, Q41, Q49-Q50, Q53-Q54, Q61-Q68, Q74-Q77. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; Bangla numerals in numeric contexts converted to Western digits).

examRules.sourceNote: Paper header (book PDF p.268) states: পূর্ণমান: ৮০ (full marks 80), ইউনিট-H, সেট-1, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা (1 hour). No further instructions are printed with this paper in Part 2 — in particular no negative-marking rule and no calculator rule appear on the header page or on any of the paper's pages (book PDF pp.268-277) — so none are recorded here. These are transcribed from the book's paper header only and are NOT entered as a verified scoring rule.
